description: THE canonical Othello instance: synthetic games from Li et al.'s generator, which draws uniformly from the legal set at every move — so uniform-over-legal is the exact conditional distribution and the Bayes-optimal predictor (bayes_ce ~ 2.009 val / 2.011 test; bayes_top1 0.1704).
generator: pim.environments.othello.vendor.othello.get_ood_game, seeded per game index: random.seed(0 * 1_000_003 + i)

train.notes: data-scale rungs are strict prefixes (M 90k ⊂ L1 1M ⊂ L2 5M ⊂ D 20M); the 10% val split is a seeded permutation applied by the training source

test.notes: the held-out gates: legal-move mass, top-1-legal, excess CE over bayes_ce

edits.notes: Li et al.'s shipped intervention cases — THE editability bench (theirs, unmodified)

probe_large.notes: added 2026-09-02 for the probe-capacity sweep (experiments/probe_capacity): 170k games ≈ 4.7M positions, 5x the canonical probe rows. Never used for canonical scoring.

disjointness: splits are disjoint index ranges of one seed; pim.environments.othello.corpus.assert_disjoint hashes actual token rows and hard-fails on overlap
provenance: corpus .npz files generated 2026-08-21 in runs/ours_on_othello/corpus (see datasets/MOVES.md); train_90000.npz.regen-dup is a byte-identical regeneration kept as evidence of determinism
